title: Foxconn says third quarter to outperform market expectations on AI strength
title_zh: 富士康表示第三季度人工智能实力超出市场预期
summary: TAIPEI, Sept 5 (Reuters) - Foxconn's third-quarter performance is expected to outperform market expectations given strong AI-related demand, the Taiwanese contract electronics maker said on Saturday,
summary_zh: 路透台北 9 月 5 日 - 台湾合约电子产品制造商富士康周六表示，鉴于人工智能相关需求强劲，预计第三季度业绩将超出市场预期。

title: Exclusive-China's Xi seeks to bring large CEO delegation on US visit, sources say
title_zh: 消息人士称，中国习近平寻求率领大型首席执行官代表团访美
summary: By Laurie Chen and Eduardo Baptista BEIJING, Sept 4 (Reuters) - President Xi Jinping is preparing a large business delegation to accompany him on his visit to Washington, two sources said, an unusual
summary_zh: 路透北京 9 月 4 日（路透社） - 两名消息人士称，习近平主席正在准备一个大型商业代表团陪同他访问华盛顿，这是一次不同寻常的情况

title: Apple's John Ternus needs to be his own type of CEO and 'not Tim Cook 2'
title_zh: 苹果公司的约翰·特努斯需要成为他自己类型的首席执行官，而不是“蒂姆·库克 2”
summary: Adobe (ADBE) is the latest company to name a new CEO — effective December 1 for Anil Chakravarthy — coming right after Apple (AAPL) began its new era under John Ternus earlier this week.
summary_zh: Adobe (ADBE) 是最新一家任命新首席执行官的公司——阿尼尔·查克拉瓦蒂 (Anil Chakravarthy) 于 12 月 1 日生效——紧接着苹果 (AAPL) 本周早些时候在约翰·特努斯 (John Ternus) 的领导下开始了新时代。

title: No steering wheel, no problem: Can Tesla speed by Cybercab probe?
title_zh: 没有方向盘，没问题：特斯拉可以通过 Cyber​​cab 探头加速吗？
summary: Federal investigators have opened an investigation into whether Tesla's (TSLA) new Cybercabs comply with federal safety standards, just as the company begins testing its service in Austin, Texas.
summary_zh: 正当特斯拉 (TSLA) 开始在德克萨斯州奥斯汀测试其服务之际，联邦调查人员已开始调查特斯拉 (TSLA) 的新型 Cyber​​cab 是否符合联邦安全标准。

title: Energy stocks could be the biggest winners of the AI boom
title_zh: 能源股可能是人工智能热潮的最大赢家
summary: Yahoo Finance Senior Business Reporter Ines Ferré discusses how major energy companies like ExxonMobil (XOM), Chevron (CVX), and ConocoPhillips (COP) are set up to be the biggest winners of the AI infrastructure boom.
summary_zh: 雅虎财经高级商业记者 Ines Ferré 讨论了埃克森美孚 (XOM)、雪佛龙 (CVX) 和康菲石油公司 (COP) 等主要能源公司如何成为人工智能基础设施热潮的最大赢家。

title: US diesel prices hit an all-time high — and it impacts you more than you might think
title_zh: 美国柴油价格创下历史新高——它对您的影响比您想象的要大
summary: US diesel prices hit a new high, with the current average sitting at $5.85 per gallon, according to AAA. Yahoo Finance Breaking Business News Reporter Jake Conley explains what's going on under the hood and highlights why diesel prices actually affect most Americans.
summary_zh: 根据 AAA 的数据，美国柴油价格创下新高，目前平均价格为每加仑 5.85 美元。雅虎财经突发商业新闻记者杰克·康利解释了幕后发生的事情，并强调了为什么柴油价格实际上影响了大多数美国人。

title: Tech stocks today: Tesla's Cybercab event fails to impress, Feds launch investigation into the robotaxi
title_zh: 今日科技股：特斯拉 Cyber​​cab 事件未能给人留下深刻印象，美联储对机器人出租车展开调查
summary: Tesla stock fell in early trading after the company's private Cybercab launch in Austin, Texas, underwhelmed Wall Street.
summary_zh: 特斯拉股价在早盘交易中下跌，此前该公司在德克萨斯州奥斯汀推出的私人 Cyber​​cab 令华尔街感到平淡。
